Alex (AE): Intro: HealthCo wants an EU-only POC for compliance review. They need a subproc list, an attestation, and ballpark pricing for ~2M tokens/month. Timeline: 3 business days for attestation. cc @Nora
Nora (Solutions): Quick Qs: BYOK required? Hosted with strict geofence ok or need dedicated? Also target latency SLO?
Ivan (Customer Sec): No BYOK for POC. Must ensure no data leaves EU. Target p95 < 300ms. Need SOC2 artifacts and 90-day log retention for the trial.
Nora (Solutions): We can do hosted geofence (fast), dedicated EU pool (stronger isolation), or private VPC (long lead). We'll propose route policy to pin tenant to EU and disable cross-border failover. Sample snippet we'll send in playbook.
Sam (Infra): I'll validate active subproc inventory and upload netdiag + certs by EOD. Hosted endpoints in eu-west/eu-central. Note: disabling cross-border failover reduces global headroom.
Mina (Pricing): Ballpark: hosted geofence ~ $1,000/mo for 2M tokens; dedicated reserve ~ $550/mo with commit; private VPC has setup fee. SOC2 artifacts or extended retention may add fee. I'll draft a formal quote after infra confirms model and concurrency.
Alex (AE): Can infra confirm subproc list today so Legal can draft attestation?
Sam (Infra): Confirming now, will upload to handoff folder and ping legal.
Alex (AE): Great, aiming to start provisioning next Tue. Thanks all.
